Dialog that matches the dataset's region names to another source

Source: R/wizard-modal_helpers.R
mapping_modal_ui.Rd

A button that opens a dialog with one row per admin level 1 name of the dataset (cache()$subnational_regions). In each row the user picks the matching name from another source: the regional survey or the shapefile. The dialog suggests matches itself and keeps the matches saved before. When the user saves, the server stores the mapping in the dataset with cache()$set_survey_mapping() or cache()$set_map_mapping(), depending on type. The two mapping steps of the wizard use it (map_survey_ui(), map_shapefile_ui()).

Usage

mapping_modal_ui(id)

mapping_modal_server(
  id,
  cache,
  survey_data,
  survey_map,
  label,
  title,
  show_col,
  type,
  i18n
)

Arguments

id

The module's id.

cache

A reactive that returns the dataset, a CacheConnection.

survey_data

A reactive that returns the other source, a data frame (the regional survey, or the shapefile). Its show_col column holds the names the user chooses from.

survey_map

A reactive that returns the mapping saved so far (a data frame as described in Details), or NULL when none is saved.

label

The translation key of the button's text, a string.

title

The translation key of the dialog's title, a string.

show_col

The column of survey_data() that holds the names to match: a string, or a function without arguments (or a reactive) that returns one. A function is called each time the value is needed, so the column can change while the app runs, as an uploaded shapefile's name column does.

type

Where the mapping is saved: "survey_mapping" (with cache()$set_survey_mapping()) or "map_mapping" (with cache()$set_map_mapping()). Any other value saves nothing.

i18n

The app's translator (a shiny.i18n translator), used for every label.

Value

mapping_modal_ui() returns the UI as Shiny tags: the placeholder the server fills with the button and its dialog. mapping_modal_server() is called for its side effects and returns nothing useful.

Details

The saved mapping is a tibble with one row per matched name and three columns: admin_level_1 (the dataset's name), a column named after show_col (the matching name in the other source) and source ("auto" when the row is the dialog's own suggestion, left unchanged, and "user" otherwise). Rows the user left without a match are not saved.

The button and dialog appear once the dataset has its admin level 1 names and survey_data() has a value.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# in a module's ui
mapping_modal_ui(ns("survey_data"))

# in its server: match the dataset's names to the regional survey's
mapping_modal_server(
  id = "survey_data",
  cache = cache,
  survey_data = reactive(cache()$regional_survey),
  survey_map = reactive(cache()$survey_mapping),
  label = "btn_upload_map_survey",
  title = "msg_upload_manual_mapping",
  show_col = "adminlevel_1",
  type = "survey_mapping",
  i18n = i18n
)
} # }
